# CANDIDATE: OFI_LEVEL_SWEEP_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A surge in cumulative order-flow imbalance (OFI) concurrent with a break of prior-day high signals aggressive buying that often extends. The OFI surge indicates strong institutional buying pressure, while the prior-day high break signals a shift in short-term market structure. Together they identify high-probability continuation moves.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: Enter long when OFI (cumulative delta) exceeds 2× its 20-bar average, price closes above the prior-day high with a bullish body >70% of the range, EMA8 > EMA21, and the opening-range low was broken earlier in the session.
Exit shape: Stop at the prior-day low (structure invalidation) or 1% ATR, TP1 at 2R, trail runner using a Chandelier exit (ATR×3).
Regime hint: Effective when VIX > 18 (high vol) and during the first 45 minutes (09:30-10:15 EST) when OFI reads are most informative.
